name: athanordb
description: Local-first DBML schema diagram editor with multi-user editing and history.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/dbml-engine
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/dbml-engine && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
